title: Grand Jury Declines to Indict Former Trump White House Aide Cassidy Hutchinson
dek: The Justice Department failed to secure an indictment against Hutchinson, who testified to the House Jan. 6 committee, the latest setback in politically sensitive cases in Washington.
author: Meridian Newsroom

image.alt: The west front of the United States Capitol building in Washington, D.C.

keyPoints: A federal grand jury declined to indict Cassidy Hutchinson, a former White House aide, the Justice Department failed to secure an indictment against her on Tuesday, according to two people familiar with the matter cited by AP.
Hutchinson gave dramatic but disputed testimony about President Donald Trump to the House select committee investigating the Jan. 6, 2021, attack on the Capitol.
Her lawyer declined to comment, and AP reports the decision is part of a wider pattern of grand juries in the nation's capital declining politically sensitive cases.
body:
A federal grand jury declined to indict Cassidy Hutchinson, a former White House aide, after the Justice Department failed to secure an indictment against her on Tuesday, according to two people familiar with the matter who spoke to the Associated Press. Reuters separately reported that a federal grand jury had declined to indict her, citing the same testimony she gave to a congressional panel.

## Who Hutchinson is

Hutchinson worked in the Trump White House and later gave testimony to the House select committee investigating the Jan. 6, 2021, attack on the U.S. Capitol. AP describes that testimony as dramatic but disputed, and it concerned President Donald Trump.

## The grand jury decision

The decision came in Washington, D.C., where grand juries have declined a number of high-profile cases in recent months. AP reports that the Justice Department has been seeking charges in several politically sensitive matters in the run-up to the midterm elections.

According to AP, Hutchinson declined to comment through her lawyer on Tuesday. Neither the Justice Department nor the grand jury has publicly detailed the basis for the case, and this report does not add any reason beyond what the people familiar with the matter have provided.

## A wider pattern

AP notes that it is highly unusual for grand juries to decline to return indictments. The same report places the case within a run of setbacks for the Justice Department, including a new attempt to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey and a federal search of the home of Rep. Ilhan Omar, a Democrat from Minnesota and an outspoken Trump critic.

## What is not yet known

The Justice Department has not publicly said whether it will pursue the matter further or seek charges in another form. Meridian will update this story if an official statement or a court filing clarifies the next step.
